::: {.experience}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml
from pathlib import Path

data = yaml.safe_load(Path("data/experience.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def one_line(s):
    return " ".join(str(s).split())

for job in data["experience"]:
    print(f"## {job['title']}\n")

    org = job["organization"]
    url = job.get("url")
    logo = job.get("logo")

    parts = []
    if logo:
        img = f"![{org}]({logo}){{height=40px}}"
        parts.append(f"[{img}]({url})" if url else img)
    parts.append(f"**[{org}]({url})**" if url else f"**{org}**")

    meta = " | ".join(x for x in [" ".join(parts)] if x)
    location= job.get("location")
    period = job.get("period")
    print(f"{meta}\\\n{location}\\\n{period}\n" if period else f"{meta}\n")

    if job.get("note"):
        print(f"*{one_line(job['note'])}*\n")

    for b in job.get("bullets") or []:
        print(f"- {b}")
    if job.get("bullets"):
        print()

    for proj in job.get("projects") or []:
        link = f" — [Campaign site]({proj['url']})" if proj.get("url") else ""
        print(f"### {proj['name']}{link}\n")
        if proj.get("description"):
            print(f"*{one_line(proj['description'])}*\n")
        for b in proj.get("bullets") or []:
            print(f"- {b}")
        print()

    print("---\n")
```
